title: Chapter 484
text:
The next moment, a terrifying pressure that shook the minds of the three Calamity Grade Supers suddenly descended, heading straight for Anur.

"What?!"

Anur's expression changed drastically.

Boom!!

Anur, who was flying at high speed, suddenly stopped. Without any warning, the air around him suddenly froze. He was like a bug trapped in amber, unable to move.

You have used [Character Summon Card: Ames]!

Anur is now in the [Freeze] state. Duration: 14 seconds.

"How is this possible?!"

This unexpected turn of events caused Anur to turn pale with fright. Could this terrifying sealing power be the Dragon Emperor's power?

It was true that Black Star was an officer of the Dragon Emperor, but why was he able to use the Dragon Emperor's power?

It had been a long time since Anur had felt panic. At this moment, his calmness was completely destroyed. No matter how hard he tried, he couldn't move an inch. He couldn't even speak. Looking at Nagojin, who was riding on flames, his eyes finally showed fear.

Bang!!

The heavy punch that was like a golden thunderbolt landed on Anur's face, and the weak wind pressure shield shattered like paper. The muffled sound of the punch hitting the body was like muffled thunder, and a golden impact ring burst out from the place where the punch landed.

This punch had been accumulating power for a long time, and its power was enough to shake mountains and destroy cities. It was enough to shatter an entire street block. However, Anur was firmly fixed in midair, and he couldn't fly out. All the power of the punch was trapped in his body.

A mouthful of smelly blood sprayed into the wind!

Bang bang bang bang!!

Nagakin roared as if he was venting all of his frustrations. His powerful punches and kicks created countless afterimages, and every single one of his attacks landed squarely on Anur. Anur was like an immovable target, unable to move at all. He had to endure the torrential attacks, and his body was constantly changing shape!

"Too savage." Han Xiao's eyelids twitched as he watched, and he almost wanted to dub Nagakin with the words' Olaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolaolai.

This was a rare opportunity, and the higher the damage, the better!

The two of them sandwiched Anur in the middle, and all the attacks were directed at him.

Without the wind pressure shield, Anur could only take the attacks with his body, and his bones were crushed!

Broken bones pierced through his skin, and blood spurted out like a fountain!

The guardian did not have time to be shocked. His mission was to prevent the deaths of the experts on both sides, and Anur was also one of his targets. Just now, he did not feel that Anur needed help, but the situation suddenly changed. The guardian quickly changed his target this time to Anur.

However, the wind pressure cannon that Anur released before he was hit happened to obstruct the guardian's footsteps, and he couldn't provide timely assistance.

After 14 seconds of berserk attacks, when the time limit was over, countless amounts of energy burst out from Anur's body.

Boom!

A bloody firework exploded in mid-air!

Metahumans who could not use their abilities had a very weak body. For example, an Metahuman with a shield could block a nuclear explosion with a shield, but it did not mean that he could block it with his body. Anur's strength was not defense, and without his speed, Han Xiao and Nagojin dealt tons of damage, and the speed at which his HP decreased could be said to be thousands of miles.

Nagakin's ferocious and ferocious combo attacks were unleashed to the fullest, and he felt very satisfied. Previously, when he was ganged up on by Anur and Ember, he had suffered quite a few injuries. Now, he had finally gotten his revenge. Usually, in a battle of the same level, after getting close, the opponent would immediately pull away. It was not like just now where he could beat the target to his heart's content.

Even if it was an ordinary person, if they did not dodge or block, they would be beaten up by another person for fourteen seconds. If the attacker wanted to kill, this amount of time was enough to kill someone.

However, Anur was still alive.

Boom!

The broken body of the Wind Demon fell to the ground and turned back to human form. It was bruised and covered in blood. There were deep wounds everywhere, and it was like a broken bag with blood flowing out.

Anur spat out large mouthfuls of blood and was on the verge of death. He could not even stand up. He stared at Han Xiao with eyes filled with shock, anger, and disbelief.

"I … I can't believe I died here …"

Nagojin clenched his fists, and his heart was full of excitement. Black Star did not go back on his words. His trust was worth it.

Han Xiao heaved a sigh of relief. He was also almost completely exhausted. Thankfully, this trump card of his had succeeded. However, he did not expect to use the Ames Character Summon Card so soon after obtaining it. He had to kill Anur to recoup his cost, and he still needed to deal the finishing blow. Thus, he extended his hand to stop Nagakin.

He had to do the last hit himself so that he could get the experience to kill the enemy.

Anur turned his head with difficulty to look at the approaching Guardian. This was his last hope.

However, the Guardian suddenly slowed down, pretending that he could not catch up.

Han Xiao did not hesitate. He raised the High Frequency Strike Cannon, faced Anur's angry eyes, and stabbed it into his chest.

Puchi!

The blade pierced through the back, but not much blood flowed out. Anur's blood was almost all gone.

Anur's body trembled, and his hand grabbed the blade. His eyes slowly became lifeless, and he looked at the sky in a daze.

His lips trembled, and he said the last sentence with difficulty. His voice was so soft that no one could hear it.

"Dark-star … Immortal."

The next second, the hand that grabbed the blade lost its strength and slid to the ground.

His life had left this body.

Han Xiao breathed a sigh of relief. At this time, a notification appeared on the interface.

You have killed Anur (Lv. 173). You have received 24.7 million EXP.

Killing a target more than 10 levels above you. Bonus 280% EXP. Personal damage: 13%

You have received an additional 8.9 million EXP.

The damage output was very low, but Han Xiao was not surprised. Nagojin was the source of the fatal damage. To be exact, Nagojin had killed Anur and reaped the benefits.

Of course, without his Character Summon Card, Nagojin would not have been able to kill Anur.

Killing Anur gave him more than 33 million EXP. This was the biggest one-time reward so far, and it could be considered as replenishing his EXP pool.

[Wind Demon — Anur] has been completed. You have received 18.2 million EXP, + 1,200 Godora Civilization Favorability, [Character Summon Card — Anur].

Godora Civilization: Friendly (2,340/3,000)

The raging storm slowly dissipated, and the pungent smell of gunpowder filled the air.

Looking at Anur's corpse, everyone, be it friend or foe, froze with their mouths agape.

They had never thought that this Calamity Grade Super would actually die here.

Even Anur himself did not expect this.

"A Calamity Grade Super has died in battle. DarkStar is probably going crazy. Because of a traitor, they lost two high-level combatants. They've suffered a huge loss. I'm afraid that I'll truly enter their sights, which will be more dangerous than before."

Han Xiao sighed. Killing Anur would probably result in negative repercussions for him. However, it had already been a life and death situation. Since things had already reached this stage, Han Xiao would not be soft-hearted and let the dying Anur go just because he was worried.

There was less than a year to Version 2.0, and he had already planned to begin his preparations after this operation. As for his attention toward Dark-star … to be honest, Han Xiao was not too worried. After all, once Version 2.0 arrived, he would have to solve the Mutation Disaster. At that time, there would be an even greater conflict with Dark-star.

Dark-star would always be an enemy that he had to deal with in the Main Storyline Storyline of Version 2.0. It was only a matter of time.

Han Xiao looked around. With Anur's death, the morale of the Dark-star warriors had instantly collapsed. However, this sealed protective shield did not allow the enemy to retreat.
